SELECT 'Q' || LPAD( NVL( MAX( TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR(QANDA_NUMBER, 2) ) ), 0 ) + 1, 4, '0' ) AS qandaNumber
FROM QNA
WHERE REGEXP_LIKE( QANDA_NUMBER, '^Q[0-9]{4}$' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QNA ( QANDA_NUMBER, SUBJECT, CATEGORY_CODE, INQUIRY_DETAILS, INQUIRER, RESPONDENT, RESPONSE_DETAILS, DATE_WRITTEN, DATE_OF_RESPONSE, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{qandaNumber}, #{subject}, #{categoryCode}, #{inquiryDetails}, #{inquirer}, NULL, NULL, SYSDATE, NULL, 'WAIT' )
mapper.select:
SELECT QANDA_NUMBER AS qandaNumber, SUBJECT AS subject, CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, INQUIRY_DETAILS AS inquiryDetails, INQUIRER AS inquirer, RESPONDENT AS respondent, RESPONSE_DETAILS AS responseDetails, DATE_WRITTEN AS dateWritten, DATE_OF_RESPONSE AS dateOfResponse, STATUS AS status
FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY DATE_WRITTEN DESC NULLS LAST, QANDA_NUMBER DESC ) AS rn,
QANDA_NUMBER, SUBJECT, CATEGORY_CODE, INQUIRY_DETAILS, INQUIRER, RESPONDENT, RESPONSE_DETAILS,
TO_CHAR( DATE_WRITTEN, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS DATE_WRITTEN,
TO_CHAR( DATE_OF_RESPONSE, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS DATE_OF_RESPONSE,
STATUS
FROM QNA
WHERE INQUIRER = #{inquirer}
AND SUBJECT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode}
AND STATUS IN ('WAIT', '답변대기')
AND STATUS IN ('WAIT', '답변대기')
AND STATUS IN ('답변완료', 'COMPLETE')
AND STATUS IN ('답변완료', 'COMPLETE')
AND STATUS = #{status}
)
WHERE rn BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
ORDER BY rn

SELECT QANDA_NUMBER AS qandaNumber, SUBJECT AS subject, CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, INQUIRY_DETAILS AS inquiryDetails, INQUIRER AS inquirer, RESPONDENT AS respondent, RESPONSE_DETAILS AS responseDetails,
TO_CHAR( DATE_WRITTEN, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS dateWritten,
TO_CHAR( DATE_OF_RESPONSE, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS dateOfResponse,
STATUS AS status
FROM QNA
WHERE QANDA_NUMBER = #{qandaNumber} AND INQUIRER = #{inquirer}
